controller: Fixed authorized primitive cursor shared by both arms. No model or provider call.
comparison: Compiled arm executes learned parent and shared typed child. Without-compilation arm executes the exact same authorized operations as independent one-operation task capsules and observes before each decision. Competent hand-authored macro executes the same operations in one state and one task under the same fixed controller.
heldoutRule: Final strings and layout schedule generated only after development validation. Whole paired sessions never enter demonstration compilation or validation.
metric: Whole-session policy observations plus runtime observation, verification and experience capture events. Final success is a separate public result read.
gate: Zero false success and strict lower paired success bootstrap95 >0 OR strict upper observation delta <0 with lower success delta >=-0.02; all exact counts and stable source.
nonClaims: Efficiency over a competent hand-authored macro
No-compilation baseline represents every possible controller
